text: Berkshire Hathaway reports Q4 operating earnings of $10.2B, down 29% year over year, with insurance underwriting profit declining 54%. Full-year operating earnings total $44.49B, below prior year. CEO transition to Greg Abel effective 2026; Warren Buffett remains chairman.

meta.note: Leadership transition coincides with earnings decline; capital allocation policy unchanged at time logged.

text: Greg Abel states Berkshire Hathaway will maintain conservative balance sheet management, capital discipline, concentrated equity holdings, and no-dividend policy. Cash stands at $373.3B. CEO assumes direct oversight of equity portfolio while Warren Buffett remains chairman.

meta.note: Leadership transition framed as cultural continuity; no change to dividend or reporting cadence policy.
